fireside.text: "Stone. We need 57 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Ursula

fireside.text: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Hank speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
You caught the lie in his face and watched the whole table react to it before he'd finished the sentence. Face and room, both open books.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and

◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ OVERTIME ×1 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+25% HP, +12% damage). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −16. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 21 days between tiers, not 7.

◈ OVERTIME ×2 — wave 4–5 monsters return as RERUNS (+50% HP, +24% damage, +1 to every pack). Raids come sooner. The table docks your standing −23. Take your seat from Haven to stop the clock. The wait stretches — the village's standing buys time: 24 days between tiers, not 7.

scaleLines.line: You remember the Rage Bindings at your space in the haven and fetch it — it rides in your pack now.
Equipped Rage Bindings (hands).
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit RAGE BINDINGS. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Rage Bindings.)

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Stonebridge and Thornfield have bound together — Stonebridge primary. Other fires are climbing, too.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Night Court is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
📺 Emma killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 4 rounds, 11 taken. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Emma killed Night Court out past the ridge — alone — and walked home. 4 rounds, 11 taken.

🔥 The fire settles. Emma has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Night Court — I put it down today." "No sound. That is the warning. The moon-shadow on the ground is growing — and there is no sound at all. Owls don't make sound when they hunt." "It missed — and it is already turning. The second dive re-aims at where you moved." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at on

Emma leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Night Court. Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Night Court: Dodge twice. No sound is the tell — watch the ground-shadow. A missed dive comes again instantly at your NEW position: dodge TWICE. Then it's exhausted, and the sky is yours. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
You don't know what that was. A walking courthouse. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
